description_en: Deletes a version of an access policy
description_zh: 调用DeletePolicyVersion删除权限策略版本
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager delete-policy-version --policy-name OSS-Administrator --version-id v3 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeletePolicyVersion

parameters.help_en:
Policy Name of the access policy.

Policy Name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短横线（-）
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the access policy version.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159982.html to query access policy version IDs
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略版本标识。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159982.html查询权限策略版本标识
parameters.name: version_id
